summary: Pre-market: the total risk score of 41.89, -0.05 on the day and -0.05 over the week, is broadly stabilizing, keeping the market in caution and in a goldilocks regime (low volatility, positive momentum, healthy breadth). Risk is concentrated in the macro dimension (63.06): the 10Y real rate of 2.41% sits at the 98.73rd percentile and the 10Y yield of 4.68% is elevated, while credit spreads stay low (HY OAS 2.84, IG OAS 0.8) and VIX at 15.99 has eased, still supporting risk appetite. NVDA rose 3.8% and TSLA 3.7% in a day, with BTC at 63827. Data is broadly degraded (news and calendar are fresh), so interpretation warrants caution.
